profile_text.body:
SpaceX describes itself as a company that designs, manufactures and launches advanced rockets and spacecraft. It says it was founded in 2002 to revolutionize space technology, with the stated ultimate goal of enabling people to live on other planets.

The company is held as a public company trading under the ticker SPCX, with CIK 0001181412 and headquarters in Starbase, Texas. It is also listed under the name SPACE EXPLORATION TECHN-CL A. Its legal exposure is recorded in Texas, with a count of 126.
